facts.fact: 朱迪思与两位朋友走到塔妮卡家门前大声敲门
facts.anchor: Judith and her friends strode up to Tanika’s house and knocked loudly on the door.

facts.fact: 开门的是位穿开衫的白发老人，他自我介绍叫萨吉德
facts.anchor: Please – it’s Sajid. And who are you?

facts.fact: 塔妮卡与患痴呆症的父亲萨吉德在餐桌旁配袜子
facts.anchor: ‘Here we go,’ Tanika said, picking up a black-and-white-striped children’s sock

facts.fact: 塔妮卡说父亲有清醒的日子也有不好的日子
facts.anchor: We have good days and we have … less good days

facts.fact: 塔妮卡以自己是家里主要收入来源、不能冒险做私下调查为由拒绝
facts.anchor: I’m the main breadwinner, and I can’t jeopardise that by doing some freelance investigating on the side.

facts.fact: 苏齐断言两起谋杀都��一枪穿心，因此肯定有关联

facts.fact: 苏齐说迈克·萨克森的书全是些打打杀杀，还提到他在非洲猎狮的照片
facts.anchor: I think there are photos of him hunting lions in Africa.

facts.fact: 贝克斯与苏齐盯住壁炉上方的镀金大镜子
facts.anchor: Becks and Suzie were staring at the large gilt mirror that hung on the wall above the fireplace.

facts.fact: 苏齐在厨房里悄悄拉贝克斯到一边，约定要去找艾勒尼警告她收手
facts.anchor: Cold calling her, and now breaking into her house. How dare she?
